result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A gives a calmer page with clear trial buttons, and it says exactly which claims it cut and why (#1, thousands of teams, AI, fake urgency). It still slips in the double-booking promise and adds features the live page never mentions ('syncs with your calendar', 'shareable booking page'). B helps readers pick a plan by saying who each one is for, but it changes 'unlimited bookings' to 'unlimited booking links', keeps the double-booking promise as 'no overlaps', invents 'manual updates across platforms', has a typo ('to to'), and explains its cuts less precisely. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B explicitly names every unsupported claim it removed and why, lays the tiers out as easy-to-compare bullets, and ends on a clear 'Start free trial' button. Both answers quietly bring back the double-booking promise (A with 'no overlaps', B with 'stops double-bookings'), and both slightly change 'unlimited bookings'. B also adds features that weren't on the live page, such as calendar sync and a shareable booking page. A has a typo, never mentions the world's #1, thousands-of-teams or AI claims in its change list, and its tier descriptions are less scannable.
